ayahs.translation: and the night when it grows still and dark.
ayahs.sahih: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,

ayahs.translation: Thy Sustainer has not forsaken thee, nor does He scorn thee:
ayahs.transliteration: Ma wad da'aka rabbuka wa ma qalaa
ayahs.sahih: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].

ayahs.translation: for, indeed, the life to come will be better for thee than this earlier part [of thy life]!
ayahs.sahih: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].

ayahs.translation: And, indeed, in time will thy Sustainer grant thee [what thy heart desires], and thou shalt be well-pleased.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa la sawfa y'uteeka rabbuka fatarda
ayahs.sahih: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.

ayahs.translation: Has He not found thee an orphan, and given thee shelter?
ayahs.transliteration: Alam ya jidka yateeman fa aawaa
ayahs.sahih: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?

ayahs.translation: And found thee lost on thy way, and guided thee?
ayahs.transliteration: Wa wa jadaka daal lan fahada
ayahs.sahih: And He found you lost and guided [you],

ayahs.translation: And found thee in want, and given thee sufficiency?
ayahs.sahih: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.

ayahs.translation: Therefore, the orphan shalt thou never wrong,
ayahs.transliteration: Fa am mal yateema fala taqhar
ayahs.sahih: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].

ayahs.translation: and him that seeks [thy] help shalt thou never chide,
ayahs.transliteration: Wa am mas saa-ila fala tanhar
ayahs.sahih: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].

ayahs.translation: and of thy Sustainer's blessings shalt thou [ever] speak.
ayahs.transliteration: Wa amma bi ni'mati rabbika fahad dith
ayahs.sahih: But as for the favor of your Lord, report [it].
